part.text:
Implemented Handlebars template engine with layouts, partials, and default-template support.

Summary of changes:
- `src/templates.ts` — new `TemplateEngine` using an isolated `Handlebars.create()` instance; discovers layouts from `templates/layouts/*.hbs` and partials from `templates/partials/*.hbs`, with `{{{body}}}` page-content placeholder and a `default` layout fallback.
- `src/markdown.ts` / `src/types.ts` — parse `template` frontmatter field into `PageMeta`.
- `src/site.ts` — `BuildOptions.templatesDir` (defaults to `./templates`), renders pages via the engine and falls back to the existing built-in HTML when no layout matches (preserving existing behavior).
- `src/cli.ts` — added `--templates`/`-t` and `--templates=` flags.
- `src/index.ts` — exports `TemplateEngine` and `PageContext`.
- `package.json` — added `handlebars` dependency.
- Tests — added `test/templates.test.ts`, extended `test/cli.test.ts` and `test/markdown.test.ts`.
